CommunityApplications.Profile:
Borg Backup UI provides an Unraid plugin for BorgBackup with a guided web interface for backup jobs, repositories, restore tests, archive browsing, reports, notifications, and system health checks.
Runtime requirement: install the separate Python 3 for UNRAID plugin before starting Borg Backup UI.
The repository contains the Borg Backup UI plugin, release metadata, documentation, screenshots, and Community Apps submission metadata.
For discussion, questions, feedback, feature suggestions, and bug reports, use the Unraid forum support thread: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/198728-plugin-borg-backup-ui-web-ui-for-borg-backup-on-unraid/
Bug reports can also be submitted directly through GitHub Issues in English or German: https://github.com/borgforge/borg-backup-ui/issues
